attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: complex_reasoning_encrypted_storage
steps:
  - id: fetch_batch_records
    op: data/fetch_batch
    params:
      source: record_queue
      status: pending
    output: batch_records

  - id: loop_over_records
    op: control/for_each
    params:
      collection: "{{batch_records}}"
      iterator_var: current_record
    steps:
      - id: apply_reasoning_rule
        op: reasoning/apply_multi_step_rule
        params:
          record: "{{current_record}}"
          ruleset: multi_step_reasoning_v1
        output: record_rule_outcome

      - id: transform_outcome
        op: transform/to_collected_format
        params:
          input: "{{record_rule_outcome}}"
          format: collected_results
        output: collected_record_result
    output: collected_results_list

  - id: aggregate_results
    op: data/aggregate
    params:
      input: "{{collected_results_list}}"
      strategy: merge_all
    output: aggregated_results

  - id: security_validation
    op: security/validate_rules
    params:
      data: "{{aggregated_results}}"
      ruleset: security_policy_v1
    output: security_validation_result

  - id: extract_sensitive_fields
    op: data/extract_fields
    params:
      source: "{{security_validation_result}}"
      field_selector: flagged_sensitive
    output: sensitive_fields

  - id: authenticate_service
    op: auth/authenticate
    params:
      service_name: reasoning_service
      auth_method: service_account
    output: auth_token

  - id: encrypt_sensitive_fields
    op: security/encrypt
    params:
      data: "{{sensitive_fields}}"
      algorithm: AES-256-GCM
      auth_token: "{{auth_token}}"
    output: encrypted_sensitive_fields

  - id: store_encrypted_results
    op: storage/write
    params:
      data:
        aggregated: "{{aggregated_results}}"
        encrypted_sensitive: "{{encrypted_sensitive_fields}}"
      destination: encrypted_results_store
      auth_token: "{{auth_token}}"
    output: storage_receipt

  - id: notify_stakeholders
    op: notify/send
    params:
      channel: email
      recipients: batch_stakeholders_group
      subject: "Batch Reasoning Run Completed"
      body: "The batch reasoning job has completed. Storage receipt: {{storage_receipt.id}}"

  - id: audit_log
    op: audit/log
    params:
      event: batch_reasoning_run_complete
      details:
        batch_size: "{{batch_records.length}}"
        aggregation_summary: "{{aggregated_results.summary}}"
        security_validation_status: "{{security_validation_result.status}}"
        storage_receipt: "{{storage_receipt}}"
      retention_policy: long_term
